question: Should outbound recovery keep ambiguous entries pending with backoff when no reconciliation-capable adapter is available, instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either behavior, but choosing recoverable pending rows changes operator expectations and upgrade behavior for ambiguous delivery state.

options.title: Accept Pending After Pacing Fix
options.body: Merge after the no-op pacing bug is fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery ledger is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a companion doctor, UI, or API surface before changing ambiguous entries to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Pending After Pacing Fix
recommendation.body: Merge after the no-op pacing bug is fixed if maintainers want ambiguous no-adapter rows to remain recoverable until adapter reconciliation ships.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses SQLite queue semantics, operator visibility, and the broader delivery consistency design where this owner has recent adjacent history.
